profile.name: Destiny Sanctuary Int'L
profile.tagline: Raising a generation that demonstrates the raw Power of God
profile.address: Destiny Sanctuary Int'L, Nyahururu, Laikipia, Kenya
profile.vision: Destiny Sanctuary exists to see every believer built, equipped, trained, empowered and made whole through the word of God and His manifest presence.
profile.mission: 1. To build a family of true sons and daughters who pursue the presence of God and demonstrate the raw power of God to our community, region, and the Nations. 2. To establish a strong base in Kenya full of the love of God to serve as a sending body to reach out into African communities with the love, compassion and the grace that sets all free. 3. To reach the unreached; the dying, hungry and needy.

announcements.title: Annual General Conference — Registration Now Open
announcements.body: Registration for the Annual General Conference is open at the office desk. Delegates from the outstations should register through their group leader so travel can be arranged together.

announcements.title: Community Food Drive & Mercy Parcel Packing Day
announcements.body: Packing day for the mercy parcels is on Saturday at the fellowship hall. Bring the family; the children can help sort the dry goods.

announcements.title: Choir & Orchestra Rehearsal Schedule Resumes
announcements.body: Rehearsals resume on Saturday at 4:00 PM. The praise set for Sunday is the one from the conference songbook.

announcements.title: Harvest Thanksgiving — Service Times Move Forward
announcements.body: From the first Sunday of March the morning service begins at 8:00 AM and the second at 10:30 AM, so the thanksgiving procession has room.

announcements.title: Baptismal Class Registration Closed
announcements.body: Registration for the February baptismal class is now closed. The next intake is announced in April.

events.title: Family Dedication Sunday
events.description: Families present their children before the congregation and commit to raising them in the Lord.

events.title: Annual General Conference
events.description: A powerful gathering of believers for spiritual renewal, prophetic teachings and community fellowship — uplifting sessions, impactful worship and transformative discussions designed to inspire and equip you for the year ahead.

events.title: National Women’s Conference
events.description: A time for women from all walks of life to come together in unity, empowerment and spiritual growth — with anointed speakers, dynamic workshops and powerful worship.

events.title: Outreach Medical Camp
events.description: Postponed to the new year — the county health team could not release the nurses for the day.

events.title: Thanksgiving Service
events.description: A time to reflect on the blessings of the year, offer heartfelt thanks, and experience a powerful time of worship, prayer and fellowship as we honour God for His goodness.

events.title: National Youth Conference
events.description: An exciting event designed for young people to experience spiritual growth, build lasting friendships and engage in vibrant discussions on faith, purpose and leadership.

meetings.title: Q1 Stated Council Conclave #2025-03
agenda: Minutes of the previous stated conclave
meetings.minutes: The Moderator opened in prayer at 7:05 PM. 7 of the church's 8 officers were present, against a quorum of 5, so the sitting was quorate. The HVAC contract was awarded and referred to the trustees for implementation. The 2025 operating budget was carried with one abstention. The bus grant was held over for the fourteen-day elder review.

meetings.title: Ordinary Council Conclave
agenda: Youth ministry bus fleet replacement grant

meetings.title: Executive Committee Session
meetings.minutes: The committee met after devotion. The annex roof repair was costed and left with the trustees for a second quotation; transport for the Ndaragwa outstation was approved within the existing vote.

resolutions.summary: Award the sanctuary climate and acoustic contract and refer implementation to the trustees.

resolutions.title: Youth Ministry Bus Fleet Replacement Grant

resolutions.summary: Raise the operating cap on the benevolence fund to fifty thousand shillings.
